t: Varta Longlife Power AA alkaline batteries deliver reliable energy for torches, flashlights, lanterns, clocks and radios on site and at home. Provides long-lasting power in energy-intensive devices. Leakproof design protects tools and equipment from damage, whilst the convenient bulk packaging ensures spares are available. Store these non-rechargeable batteries for up to 10 years, making them ideal for emergency kits and backup power supplies.
